description: This file defines the InteropTransactionsData class, which extends CommandProcessingResult. It encapsulates a list of InteropTransactionData objects and provides a static build method to create an instance based on a SavingsAccount and a predicate filter. The class handles sorting transactions by date and ID.

classes.name: InteropTransactionsData
classes.description: A data class extending CommandProcessingResult, representing a collection of interoperation transaction data associated with a savings account.

methods.name: InteropTransactionsData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with an entity ID and a list of transaction data.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static method that builds an InteropTransactionsData instance from a SavingsAccount, filtering and sorting its transactions based on the provided predicate.
